notes:
Profiles, a setup page for new profiles, and a fix for games with an anti-cheat.

- Profiles: click your picture in the title bar to switch between Steam accounts or add another one. Adding a profile asks you to sign in with Steam, and each profile keeps its own sign-in, so you can switch back and forth without signing in again. Profiles are also listed in Settings > Account, where you can switch or remove one. Sign out now really signs the profile out.
- A profile you just added opens on a full-screen page to set up its SteamLite account: message notifications, Windows notifications, message sound, friend requests and streak reminders. These switches belong to each profile and can be changed later in Settings > Sound & alerts.
- Games with an anti-cheat (Easy Anti-Cheat, BattlEye) are no longer counted as closed when their launcher quits. SteamLite now also asks Steam whether the game is running, waits a short time before calling a game closed (longer for anti-cheat games), and ignores a process listing that fails. The Stop button can still close such a game.
